title: TransactionDetectedEvent
description: Emitted by gateway when a financial transaction alert email or webhook is parsed

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event instance (idempotency key)

occurred_at.description: Timestamp when the transaction occurred according to the bank alert

account_number_mask.description: Masked bank account or card number (e.g. *1234)

transaction_type.description: Whether money was deducted (DEBIT) or added (CREDIT)

remaining_balance.description: Available balance after transaction, if reported

description.description: Raw or normalized transaction description / merchant memo

counterparty.description: Normalized merchant, payee, sender, or counterparty name extracted by LLM

category.description: Semantic expense or income category (e.g. Food & Beverage, Transport, Utility, Salary)

raw_source_ref.description: Reference ID back to original raw email message-id or webhook id
